title: QtCraft API
description: QtCraft Widget API -- A UI framework for Minecraft based on Qt.
body:
# **A Qt UI framework**
Enables mod developers to build rich, flexible GUIs using familiar Qt paradigms — signals & slots, layouts, stylesheets, model/view, and a full widget hierarchy. 

We have QtCraft [Demo](https://github.com/EDGtheXu/QtCraft/tree/master/example) to display:
### GUI Widget

![GUI Widget](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6dac080a255231c9fc29e48b8182036f95f30550.png)


### Block Widget
Moreover you can display these UI in the block easily just like:

![Block Widget](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7d63d1ce9f58f20b415cff3c10c5e6ca03806871.png)

### More Features
More features are in the [GitHub](https://github.com/EDGtheXu/QtCraft/)
